  tryCatch({

    }
    # Try different possible repository names
    devtools::install_github("omicwas/omicwas")
    library(omicwas)
    cat("Successfully installed omicwas from alternative GitHub repo\n")
  }, error = function(e2) {
    cat("Alternative GitHub installation also failed\n")
    
    # Method 3: Use MatrixEQTL as alternative for QTL analysis
    cat("Installing MatrixEQTL as alternative for QTL analysis\n")
    if (!require("MatrixEQTL", quietly = TRUE)) {
      install.packages("MatrixEQTL")
    }
    library(MatrixEQTL)
    
    # Load formatted matrices
    X <- read.csv("/mnt/data/lengyang/youjia_project/autoba/BABench/src/promptbio-bench/tasks/a-15-2/result_10/toolsgenie_20260516/snp_genotypes_formatted.csv", row.names=1)

    W <- read.csv("/mnt/data/lengyang/youjia_project/autoba/BABench/src/promptbio-bench/tasks/a-15-2/result_10/toolsgenie_20260516/cell_composition_formatted.csv", row.names=1)
    C <- read.csv("/mnt/data/lengyang/youjia_project/autoba/BABench/src/promptbio-bench/tasks/a-15-2/result_10/toolsgenie_20260516/covariates_formatted.csv", row.names=1)
    
    # Load position data frames
    snp_pos_df <- read.csv("/mnt/data/lengyang/youjia_project/autoba/BABench/src/promptbio-bench/tasks/a-15-2/result_10/toolsgenie_20260516/snp_positions_formatted.csv", row.names=1)
    cpg_pos_df <- read.csv("/mnt/data/lengyang/youjia_project/autoba/BABench/src/promptbio-bench/tasks/a-15-2/result_10/toolsgenie_20260516/methylation_positions_formatted.csv", row.names=1)
    
    # Convert matrices to proper format
    X <- as.matrix(X)
    Y <- as.matrix(Y)
    W <- as.matrix(W)
    C <- as.matrix(C)
    
    # Print dimensions for verification
    cat("Data dimensions:\n")
    cat("X (SNPs):", dim(X), "\n")
    cat("Y (methylation):", dim(Y), "\n")
    cat("W (cell composition):", dim(W), "\n")
    cat("C (covariates):", dim(C), "\n")
    
    # Perform cell-type-specific QTL analysis using MatrixEQTL approach
    # Create results data frame to store all associations
    all_results <- data.frame()
    
    # Define cis-window (1 Mb = 1,000,000 bp)
    cis_window <- 1000000
    
    # For each cell type, perform QTL analysis
    cell_types <- colnames(W)
    
    for (cell_type in cell_types) {
      cat("Analyzing cell type:", cell_type, "\n")
      
      # Create cell-type-specific expression by weighting
      # This approximates cell-type-specific analysis
      cell_weight <- W[, cell_type]
      
      # Weight the methylation data by cell type proportion
      Y_weighted <- sweep(Y, 2, cell_weight, "*")
      
      # For each CpG site
      for (cpg_idx in 1:nrow(Y)) {
        cpg_id <- rownames(Y)[cpg_idx]
        cpg_pos <- cpg_pos_df[cpg_id, "pos"]
        cpg_chr <- cpg_pos_df[cpg_id, "chr"]
        
        # Find SNPs within cis-window
        cis_snps <- which(snp_pos_df$chr == cpg_chr & 
                         abs(snp_pos_df$pos - cpg_pos) <= cis_window)
        
        if (length(cis_snps) > 0) {
          for (snp_idx in cis_snps) {
            snp_id <- rownames(X)[snp_idx]
            
            # Prepare data for linear model
            snp_genotype <- X[snp_idx, ]
            cpg_methylation <- Y_weighted[cpg_idx, ]
            
            # Create data frame for analysis
            analysis_data <- data.frame(
              methylation = cpg_methylation,
              genotype = snp_genotype,
              C
            )
            
            # Remove samples with missing data
            complete_samples <- complete.cases(analysis_data)
            analysis_data <- analysis_data[complete_samples, ]
            
            if (nrow(analysis_data) > 10) {  # Ensure sufficient samples
              # Fit linear model
              model <- lm(methylation ~ genotype + ., data = analysis_data)
              
              # Extract results for genotype effect
              coef_summary <- summary(model)$coefficients
              if ("genotype" %in% rownames(coef_summary)) {
                estimate <- coef_summary["genotype", "Estimate"]
                std_error <- coef_summary["genotype", "Std. Error"]
                t_value <- coef_summary["genotype", "t value"]
                p_value <- coef_summary["genotype", "Pr(>|t|)"]
                
                # Add to results
                result_row <- data.frame(
                  term = snp_id,
                  response = cpg_id,
                  celltype = cell_type,
                  estimate = estimate,
                  statistic = t_value,
                  p.value = p_value,
                  std.error = std_error,
                  n_samples = nrow(analysis_data)
                )
                
                all_results <- rbind(all_results, result_row)
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Save results
    if (nrow(all_results) > 0) {
      write.table(all_results, "/mnt/data/lengyang/youjia_project/autoba/BABench/src/promptbio-bench/tasks/a-15-2/result_10/toolsgenie_20260516/mQTL_results.tsv", 
                  sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
      
      cat("Analysis complete. Results saved with", nrow(all_results), "associations\n")
      cat("Column names:\n")
      print(colnames(all_results))
      
      # Display first few results
      cat("First 5 results:\n")
      print(head(all_results, 5))
      
      # Summary by cell type
      cat("Summary by cell type:\n")
      print(table(all_results$celltype))
    } else {
      cat("No significant associations found\n")
    }
  })
})
